item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 10/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream now affecting the coast of Guangdong will moderate gradually and will be replaced by a maritime airstream in the next couple of days. It will be rather warm during the day over the region. The weather will be humid with fog in the middle and latter parts of this week. A cold front is expected to move across southern China on Saturday and bring showers to the region. Under the influence of the associated dry northeast monsoon, it will become cool and the weather will improve over the coast of southern China early next week.
